title: GAV: A scientific experimentation environment for PDE agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.30292v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable feedback is essential for coding agents to develop programs for partial differential equations (PDEs). Yet evaluating these programs on new PDE problems often requires expensive reference computations, while fixed datasets restrict the range of experiments. We introduce Generator-Agent-Verifier (GAV), a scientific experimentation environment that makes new PDE problems verifiable by construction. The Generator learns a distribution of continuous reference solutions using data from numerical simulations or experimental measurements to represent a target physical regime. Using the method of manufactured solutions, it works backward from the generated reference solutions to construct matching PDE problems without a separate numerical solve. translated_title: GAV：一个面向偏微分方程智能体的科学实验环境
translated_abstract: 可靠的反馈对于编码智能体开发偏微分方程（PDE）程序至关重要。然而，在新PDE问题上评估这些程序通常需要昂贵的参考计算，而固定数据集又限制了实验的范围。我们提出了生成器-智能体-验证器，这是一个使新PDE问题在构造上即可验证的科学实验环境。生成器利用来自数值模拟或实验测量的数据学习连续参考解的分布，以表示目标物理区域；并借助制造解方法，从生成的参考解反向构造出匹配的PDE问题，而无需单独的数值求解。智能体负责设计实验、调查失败原因，并迭代改进其程序。验证器则根据参考解评估候选程序并提供数值反馈。
tldr: 该论文提出GAV框架，通过生成器构造可验证的新PDE问题、智能体迭代开发与调试程序、验证器提供数值反馈，为PDE编码智能体建立了一个无需昂贵参考计算的科学实验环境。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes GAV, a Generator-Agent-Verifier scientific environment where new PDE problems are verifiable by construction, enabling coding agents to iteratively develop and refine PDE programs with reliable numerical feedback without costly reference computations.
